project.name: Gimle Testkit
project.description: Reusable real-cluster test infrastructure shared across this repo's own test-only modules: Heimdall (an event-driven cluster-condition watcher -- conditions complete on the satisfying event instead of polling, and a timed-out or failed condition throws a forensic report of the last observed cluster state), a spin-polling Await primitive, and PortLease (kernel-assigned loopback port reservation so concurrent real-cluster fixtures never collide). Originally built inside gimle-holmgang and extracted here once gimle-smoke-tests needed the same machinery.
